{{recipe}}

'''Marzipan cake''' with biscuit and cream.

==Ingredients==
===Cake base===
* 75 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 125 g white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 packet [[Cookbook:Vanilla Sugar|vanilla sugar]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 100 g [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 100 g ground [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]

===Filling===
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]
* a few drops [[Cookbook:Almond Extract|almond flavor]]
* 1 tablespoon white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 tablespoons water
* 2 packets of no-cook [[Cookbook:Pectin|pectin]]
* 600 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]]
* 75 g [[Cookbook:Marzipan|marzipan]]

===Ornament===
* 350 g marzipan
* 50 g chopped almonds
* 50 g [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* 200 ml whipping cream, [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]]
* starch-based creamer
* 50 g whole milk [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] couverture

==Procedure==
===Cake base===

# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 180 °C.
# Melt butter in a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and let cool slightly. 
# Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl with a [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]] at the highest level until frothy. While stirring, sprinkle in sugar mixed with vanilla sugar, then beat the mixture for 2 minutes.
# Combine the flour, baking powder and almonds. Stir in briefly at the lowest setting, then stir in the butter briefly.
# Spread the batter in a [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for 30 minutes.
# Let the cake base cool and cut twice horizontally. Place one of the cake bases on a cake platter.

===Filling===

# Stir the jam until smooth and spread on the bottom cake base.
# Place the middle cake base on top of the jam, and press gently to secure the layers.
# Cut the marzipan into small pieces and place in a mixing bowl. Add the bitter almond flavor, sugar, and water, and stir until smooth with the mixer.
# Whip the cream with pectin stiffly according to the package instructions. Mix in the marzipan.
# Spread about ¾ of the cream on the middle cake layer, and put the final layer on top. 
# Spread the cake completely with the remaining cream. Place the cake in the fridge for at least 3 hours.

===Decorate===

# Place a piece [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|baking paper]] on a large plate. 
# Crush the couverture and melt it in a bowl over a water bath. Mix the almonds with the chocolate coating. 
# Spoon 16 small dollops of the almond-chocolate mixture on the baking paper, and keep in the fridge until the chocolate has set.
# Sift powdered sugar and [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] into the marzipan. Roll out the marzipan mixture into a round flat disc (Ø=36 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]). 
# Drape the marzipan over the cake. Press the marzipan onto the edge of the cake. Cut off any excess marzipan.
# Prepare cream and transfer to a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|piping bag]]. Decorate the cake with cream. 
# Place almond slivers on top and place the cake in the fridge until ready to serve.
